title: Change Counter Attack to Specific Skill

posts.author: Truant99
posts.body: Hello, I would like an enemy to counter with a specific skill as opposed to a generic attack. Is there a way to get this effect via MZ or through a plugin?

posts.author: Truant99
posts.body: This has an odd effect. It does the physical regular attack then it adds the other skill. It's close to working, but ideally it wouldn't trigger a regular attack.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Are you using some plugins already if you get some odd effects? In base rpg maker it doesn't even show any animations for counter attacks. Also, if you replace the attack skill like that, you can't use it for other purposes any more (though that might not be a problem for you).
For a plugin there's VisuStella auto skill triggers, where you can set the conditions you want and the rate equal to the counter attack chance rate. But if you want it to only happen during states etc, you'd need to use workarounds. Like control enemy mp/tp to decide when the counter can be used I think. (Or try and edit the obfuscated code, or maybe edit the skill note/meta percentage).

posts.author: sunhihi
posts.body: It’s not that these kinds of plugins don’t exist, but since they are based on the MZ core, they are difficult to make compatible with other plugins. As a result, many of these plugins are either incomplete or tightly bound to the other plugins created by their authors.
